function: Joint learned active beamforming at the BS, passive beamforming at the IRS and WPT time allocation to maximize the secondary-link sum data rate (pp. 5-6).
system: BS with T=4 antennas, M=4 single-antenna users, 3 single-antenna backscatter devices per cluster, reflecting passive IRS with Q elements, 3.6 GHz (pp. 3, 7).
method: DDPG deep reinforcement learning (actor-critic, two hidden layers), trained online with experience replay by interacting with the channel environment (pp. 6-7).
data_channel: Custom simulation: Rayleigh BS-user and BS-BD links, Rician IRS-related channels (kappa=10), perfect CSI, 3.6 GHz, distance ranges in Table II; no dataset (pp. 4, 7).
test_conditions: Single setup (M=4, N=3, T=4); sweeps of Pmax, Q, Rmin and learning rate evaluated in the same environment; no unseen scenario (pp. 7-9).
baselines: Three own schemes: without IRS and WPT, without IRS, fixed WPT time; no earlier learned method; solver of the schemes not stated (pp. 7, 9).
metrics: Sum data rate of secondary links (bps/Hz), reward convergence versus iterations, gains in dB over comparison schemes (pp. 8-9).
q1_support: p. 4: "we model the small-scale fading of the IRS-related channels as Rician fading" and the other links as Rayleigh; custom simulator, with no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data mentioned.
q2_support: p. 10: "Future research may explore the extension of the proposed IRS- and WPT-assisted SR system to dynamic network environments". Pp. 8-9 only sweep Pmax, Q, Rmin and lr in one simulator; no trained model is tested in an unseen condition.
q3_support: p. 7: "we introduce three comparison schemes for performance evaluation" (without IRS and WPT, without IRS, fixed WPT), which are system variants of the proposal; no earlier learned method is compared and no non-learned algorithm is named.
q4_support: p. 8: "the algorithm converges to the maximum reward value after approximately 400 iterations" is the only cost-like figure; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 7: "We implement our DDPG-based capacity optimization algorithm using the PyTorch 1.10.0 simulation platform"; no code or data link, and no public or measured dataset is mentioned.
notes: Area 3: DDPG learns the BS beamformer, the IRS phase shifts and the WPT time split in a symbiotic-radio system. Table I (p. 3) and Table II (p. 7) were read from page images. Table II lists Q = 25~100 while the text and Figs. 6-9 use Q = 5 to 30. The text says 'traditional methods' (p. 7) but does not state the algorithm of the comparison schemes.
